title: Validate desktop operation requests
responsibility: Builds the allowed request shape for desktop operations and rejects invalid field values.

inputs.name: approvalPayload.value
inputs.description: The untrusted approval object must contain a valid version, an imageHashes array of at most 24 entries, and a valid contractHash. Version and hash values pass imported pattern validators; a supplied option must be o1 through o10.
inputs.unknownReason: The approval comes from IPC and is validated before its fields are used.

inputs.name: threadPayload.x
inputs.description: The thread request names an entity and supplies either a complete image anchor or null for version, imageSha256, state, and viewport. A null version requires a null region; an optional option must be o1 through o10.
inputs.unknownReason: The IPC thread request is checked field by field, including its optional image anchor.

inputs.name: creationProject.value
inputs.description: The project identity is either local- followed by 64 hexadecimal characters or a UUID-shaped string. Matching is case-insensitive.
inputs.unknownReason: The project identifier comes from unvalidated IPC data and is narrowed to a supported identifier string.

inputs.name: creationPayload.x
inputs.description: The creation request allows only intent, projectId, category, mode, provider, model, effort, text, and optional designOptions. It requires create intent, plan mode, a catalog category, a codex or claude provider, and text of at most 20,000 characters; designOptions, when present, is an integer from 1 to 10.

examples.text: Add a filter to the report list.

inputs.unknownReason: The incoming agent creation request is narrowed to the allowed Plan fields.

inputs.name: runPayload.x
inputs.description: Accepts an existing-entity run request, an intent=create request, or an intent=task request. Run text is limited to 20,000 characters; task conversations default to an empty array and may contain at most 20 entries with text up to 4,000 characters each, while change runs require approval and forbid designOptions.
inputs.unknownReason: The agent request is narrowed by intent and may carry one of several payload shapes.

inputs.name: ipcPayload.channel
inputs.description: The channel string selects the payload parser. project:open and providers:list return null without parsing input; unrecognized channel strings fall through to entityPayload.

inputs.name: ipcPayload.input
inputs.description: The untrusted value passed to the selected channel parser. project:open and providers:list ignore it; other channels pass it through the selected field and payload validators.
inputs.unknownReason: The IPC channel selects the request parser, with some channels carrying no payload.

outputs.name: approvalPayload
outputs.type: { option?: undefined; version: string; imageHashes: string[]; contractHash: string; } | { option: string; version: string; imageHashes: string[]; contractHash: string; }
outputs.description: Returns version, imageHashes, and contractHash, adding option only when it was supplied. Returned version and hash values have passed their imported validators.

outputs.name: threadPayload
outputs.type: { option?: undefined; entityId: string; version: string | null; imageSha256: string | null; state: string | null; viewport: string | null; region: Region | null; } | { option: string; entityId: string; version: string | null; imageSha256: string | null; state: string | null; viewport: string | null; region: Region | null; }
outputs.description: Returns entityId, version, imageSha256, state, viewport, and region, adding option only when supplied. Image-anchor fields are either all non-null or all null, and a null version requires a null region.

outputs.name: creationProject
outputs.description: Returns the accepted project identity unchanged. It is local- followed by 64 hexadecimal characters or a UUID-shaped string, matched case-insensitively.

outputs.name: creationPayload
outputs.type: { designOptions?: undefined; intent: "create"; projectId: string; category: "components" | "pages" | "apis" | "layouts" | "functions" | "configs" | "services" | "models"; mode: "plan"; provider: "claude" | "codex"; model: string; effort: string | null; text: string; } | { designOptions: number; intent: "create"; projectId: string; category: "components" | "pages" | "apis" | "layouts" | "functions" | "configs" | "services" | "models"; mode: "plan"; provider: "claude" | "codex"; model: string; effort: string | null; text: string; }
outputs.description: Returns intent, projectId, category, mode, provider, model, effort, and text, adding designOptions only when supplied. designOptions must be an integer from 1 to 10 and text is limited to 20,000 characters.

examples.text: Add a filter to the report list.

outputs.name: runPayload
outputs.description: Returns one validated existing-entity run, creation request, or task request shape. Omitted optional fields stay omitted; an omitted task conversation becomes an empty array, with at most 20 entries and 4,000 characters of text per entry.

outputs.name: ipcPayload
outputs.description: Returns null for project:open and providers:list, or the selected operation’s validated payload. Entity-history pages must be integers from 1 to 10,000, and entity-source paths are limited to 1,000 characters.

errors.name: InvalidPayloadError
errors.description: Thrown when an input object or field fails validation, a thread has an incomplete image anchor or a region on a draft, a creation request has invalid keys or project identity, a change lacks approval or supplies designOptions, or an entity-history page is outside 1 to 10,000. Imported plan, evidence, and field validators can also throw Error for invalid selected-channel payloads.

inputs.name: approvalPayload.value
inputs.description: The untrusted approval object must contain a valid version, an imageHashes array of at most 24 entries, and a valid contractHash. Version and hash values pass imported pattern validators; a supplied option must be o1 through o10.
inputs.unknownReason: The approval comes from IPC and is validated before its fields are used.

outputs.name: approvalPayload
outputs.type: { option?: undefined; version: string; imageHashes: string[]; contractHash: string; } | { option: string; version: string; imageHashes: string[]; contractHash: string; }
outputs.description: Returns version, imageHashes, and contractHash, adding option only when it was supplied. Returned version and hash values have passed their imported validators.

errors.name: Invalid approval payload
errors.description: Thrown when the value is not a valid object, imageHashes is not an array or has more than 24 entries, or an approval field fails its validator.

inputs.name: threadPayload.x

inputs.unknownReason: The IPC thread request is checked field by field, including its optional image anchor.

outputs.name: threadPayload
outputs.description: Returns entityId, version, imageSha256, state, viewport, and region, adding option only when supplied. Image-anchor fields are either all non-null or all null, and a null version requires a null region.

errors.name: InvalidPayloadError
errors.description: Thrown when a thread field fails validation, the image-anchor fields do not all have the same null status as version, or a null version is paired with a non-null region.

inputs.unknownReason: The project identifier comes from unvalidated IPC data and is narrowed to a supported identifier string.

outputs.name: creationProject
outputs.description: Returns the accepted project identity unchanged. It is local- followed by 64 hexadecimal characters or a UUID-shaped string, matched case-insensitively.

errors.name: InvalidPayloadError
errors.description: Thrown unless the value is a string matching local- plus 64 hexadecimal characters or a UUID-shaped identity.
